caseName: Angelone v. Stewart ex rel. Rausch
caseNameFull: Angelone, Director, Virginia Department of Corrections v. Stewart, By and Through Rausch

opinions.text: Application to vacate the stay of execution of sentence of death granted by the United States District Court for the Eastern District of Virginia on July 3, 1996, presented to The Chief Justice, and by him referred to the Court, denied.
